name: Tempester 1.5.5.0 — more fixes, clearer update screen
summary: A second batch of safe fixes, a clearer OS update screen, and 1,584 bytes of code space freed.

fixes: Exporting a whole project needs half the working memory, which leaves a safer margin.
Play List Delete Step no longer overwrites the next list.
Copying a sequence into another beat finds its free slot in that beat.
Recording a note with a Note FX value no longer changes an unrelated setting (FX2 used to set the half-step flag).
Crossed note-offs reach the right voice.
Loading a beat with an out-of-range Voice Assign no longer upsets the voices.
changes: The OS update screen tells you what to do: « Writing... DO NOT POWER OFF. », then « When the FX1 LEDs stop: done, power off and on. » (shown from the next update made on this version).
The three Debug-menu OS senders (Main, Voice, Panel) share one routine: same behaviour, 1,584 bytes freed.

description: 1.5.3.0 plus patches n°2d, 7d, 10, 11, 12, 13 (the former 1.5.4.0), n°14 clearer update message (the former 1.5.4.1) and n°15 code-size optimisation: the three Debug-menu OS senders merged into one routine (1,584 bytes freed), same behaviour. Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
